files.role: Pure plan logic (PLAN1, OUT1): schema CoachPlanV1, validation, overrides, rendering, outcome. No database, no clock, no network. CoachPlanV1 (JSON shape, declared once here; Kotlin CoachPlan mirrors it): {schema_version: int (== COACH_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION), type: COACH_PLAN_TYPES, title: str 1..80, rationale: str|null <= 400, target_distance_m: number|null > 0, segments: [{kind: COACH_SEGMENT_KINDS, duration_s: int >= COACH_MIN_SEGMENT_S, hr: {min: int, max: int}|null, pace: {fast_s_per_km: int, slow_s_per_km: int}|null, cadence: {min: int, max: int}|null}] (1..COACH_MAX_SEGMENTS items, total duration COACH_MIN_PLAN_S..COACH_MAX_PLAN_S), triggers: [COACH_TRIGGERS] (omitted or empty = all enabled; unknown value = invalid)}. Range rules: lo < hi, hi - lo >= the COACH_MIN_RANGE_* of the dimension, ends within COACH_HR_BOUNDS / COACH_PACE_BOUNDS_S_PER_KM / [CAD_MIN_SPM, CAD_MAX_SPM], fast_s_per_km < slow_s_per_km. Type/segment rules: non-interval types contain only warmup/steady/cooldown with exactly one steady segment; interval contains >= 2 work and >= 1 recovery segment; hr_controlled needs hr on every steady segment. Extra keys are invalid. Reason codes: plan_schema, plan_bounds, plan_type_segments, plan_interval_frequency.

methods.name: validate_plan
methods.purpose: PLAN1: parse + all bounds/type rules; recent_plan_types = types of the latest COACH_INTERVAL_LOOKBACK_PLANS plans (created_at DESC, statuses other than disregarded/superseded) for the interval-frequency rule; raises PlanRejected.

methods.name: apply_overrides
methods.purpose: PlanOverrides semantics (omitted key unchanged, null clears, object sets; applied to every steady and work segment; target_distance_m at plan level), then validate_plan with recent_plan_types=[] (the frequency rule is not re-applied); raises PlanRejected('plan_bounds' | 'plan_type_segments'); the router maps it to PLAN_INVALID 422.

methods.name: plan_total_s

methods.name: plan_summary
methods.purpose: One-line server-rendered text for PlanRow.summary, e.g. 'Easy continuous - 40 min - HR 130-145 - cadence 165-175'; unknown targets omitted.

methods.name: first_targets

methods.name: compute_outcome
methods.purpose: OUT1: pauses are (start_s, end_s) offsets since started_at; active time of a series point t = t - total pause length before t; points beyond plan_total_s or without a segment target are not evaluated; returns {planned_s, done_s, completed, in_range:{hr,pace,cadence}, avg_hr, avg_pace_s_per_km, avg_cadence_spm}; in_range values are fractions rounded to 0.01 or null.

files.role: Pure profile logic (PROF1). RunFacts is defined in coach_payload.py and imported here (one direction: coach_profile imports coach_payload, never the reverse).

methods.name: compute_measured_profile
methods.purpose: window = latest COACH_MEASURED_WINDOW_RUNS complete runs, newest first; returns rows {key, value_text, value_num, unit, n_runs} for every COACH_MEASURED_KEYS entry that has a basis (absent otherwise; never 0).

methods.name: validate_profile_updates
methods.purpose: PROF1: [] when n_runs < COACH_MIN_RUNS_INFERRED; else keeps entries with key in COACH_INFERRED_KEYS, value text 1..200 chars, confidence number in [0,1] capped at min(0.9, 0.2 + 0.1 x n_runs); unknown keys and malformed entries are dropped; at most one entry per key (first wins).

files.role: Allow-list payload builder (PAY1, EGR1). The ONLY code that shapes what is sent. PAYLOAD_V1_KEYS (declared once here) = {payload_version, plan_schema_version, goal, profile: [{key, basis, value_text, value_num, unit, confidence}], current_run: RUN + {splits: [{km, duration_s, pace_s_per_km, avg_hr}], first_half: {avg_pace_s_per_km, avg_hr}, second_half: {avg_pace_s_per_km, avg_hr}, series: {step_s, pace: [number|null], hr: [number|null], cadence: [number|null]}}, history: [RUN], previous_recommendation: {plan_type, planned_s, status, outcome: {completed, in_range: {hr, pace, cadence}, avg_hr, avg_pace_s_per_km, avg_cadence_spm}}|null}; RUN = {days_before, weekday, run_kind, distance_m, moving_s, avg_pace_s_per_km, avg_hr, max_hr, avg_cadence_spm, avg_step_length_m, hrr60, hrr120, followed_plan: {plan_type, completed, in_range: {hr, pace, cadence}}|null}. No other key may appear at any depth; values are numbers, short strings from fixed vocabularies, nulls, or the user's goal text.

public_objects.name: PAYLOAD_V1_KEYS

methods.name: refresh_measured_profile

methods.name: count_window_runs

Its value is the n_runs passed to validate_profile_updates and save_analysis.

LiveRunState gains `coach: CoachUiState? = null` (default). New members: setCoachMuted, setCoachEnabled, setCoachFrequency, refreshCoachPlan. All coach calls are wrapped so no exception reaches recording (REL2).
